description:
CryptoPulse: Global cryptocurrency intelligence API. 10 endpoints: DeFi yield farming across Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Solana (DeFiLlama live TVL + APY), personalized strategy builder, crypto security framework (with

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • strategy ($0.20): Build a personalized DeFi strategy for goals and risk
  • security ($0.10): Scan token/address risk and harden self-custody setup
  • threats ($0.10): Report current crypto threats and active scam patterns
  • exchange ($0.10): Compare crypto exchanges on fees, custody, jurisdiction
  • tax ($0.20): Explain crypto tax treatment for a given jurisdiction
  • onboard ($0.10): Guide a first-time crypto buyer from zero to first hold
  • spend ($0.10): Find where to spend crypto and how to pay with it
  • banking ($0.10): Find crypto-friendly banks and fiat on/off ramps
  • merchant ($0.10): Set up crypto payment acceptance for a merchant
  • options-greeks ($0.02): Options pricing + greeks calculator (Black-Scholes / Black-76) — deterministic
  • funding-check ($0.02): Perp funding-rate check (Hyperliquid, cross-venue normalized) — deterministic
  • funding-arb-scan ($0.05): Cross-venue funding-arbitrage scan — deterministic
  • volatility-check ($0.02): Perp volatility check (realized vol, NATR, Bollinger) — deterministic
  • funding-history ($0.05): Perp funding-rate history — lookahead-safe, deterministic
  • dydx-history ($0.02): dYdX v4 chain-state history — block-stamped OI + funding index
  • research-brief ($0.50): Deliver an institutional crypto brief: spot, derivs, flows
  • equity-marks ($0.03): 24/7 stock, commodity, FX and index marks (Hyperliquid HIP-3) — deterministic
  • hip3-markets ($0.02): Hyperliquid HIP-3 dex + market catalog, enumerated live — deterministic
  • event-odds ($0.03): Real-money event odds from Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets — deterministic
  • mark-quality ($0.03): Trust score for Hyperliquid HIP-3 perp marks (oracle divergence × liquidity) — deterministic
  • lending-rates ($0.03): Hyperliquid native borrow-lend market rates — deterministic
  • staking-intel ($0.03): Hyperliquid HYPE staking + validator intelligence — deterministic
  • whale-positions ($0.03): Full perp positions for any Hyperliquid wallet — deterministic
  • equity-positioning ($0.03): Stock-perp positioning: funding + open interest crowding (Hyperliquid HIP-3) — deterministic
  • research-snapshot ($0.25): Deterministic data-only crypto snapshot (price/market-structure/sentiment) — $0.25 preview of research-brief
  • trader-record ($0.05): Verify any Hyperliquid wallet track record, deterministic
  • top-traders ($0.05): Rank Hyperliquid traders for copying, deterministic
  • vault-screener ($0.03): Screen Hyperliquid vaults on drawdown, deterministic
  • builder-stats ($0.03): Report builder-code revenue per Hyperliquid app
  • monday-open-signal ($0.03): Compare weekend stock marks with Friday close
  • oi-caps ($0.02): Check open-interest cap usage on Hyperliquid
  • new-listings ($0.02): List new and retired Hyperliquid markets
  • sports-odds ($0.03): Decode sports odds from Hyperliquid HIP-4 markets
  • liquidation-watch ($0.05): Map positions near liquidation on Hyperliquid
  • hl-alerts ($0.25): Register a 24h Hyperliquid alert with callback

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: strategy | security | threats | exchange | tax | onboard | spend | banking | merchant | options-greeks | funding-check | funding-arb-scan | volatility-check | funding-history | dydx-history | research-brief | equity-marks | hip3-markets | event-odds | mark-quality | lending-rates | staking-intel | whale-positions | equity-positioning | research-snapshot | trader-record | top-traders | vault-screener | builder-stats | monday-open-signal | oi-caps | new-listings | sports-odds | liquidation-watch | hl-alerts

activities.description: Comma-separated: hold, trade, defi, mining, staking, nft, business

address.description: Optional wallet address to screen via GoPlus (sanctions, phishing, mixer, malicious activity)

callback.description: https URL to POST signed events to

category.description: Threat category: phishing, drainer, sim_swap, rug_pull, flash_loan, or all

coin.description: Perp symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL...) — omit for top markets by open interest

competition.description: filter by competition substring, e.g. europa, nfl

date.description: UTC day YYYYMMDD for the statement (default yesterday)

days.description: Window length in days (max 90 per call)

depth_for_top.description: read the live order book for the first N questions (default 3, max 10)

details_for_top.description: fetch followers, leader share and full-curve drawdown for the top N (max 10)

dex.description: one dex (xyz, mkts, para, io, ... or native); default all

end.description: ISO date anchoring the window end (default now)

expiry.description: ISO expiry date (08:00 UTC assumed) — or pass t

include_settled.description: include settled or past-deadline questions (default false)

iv.description: Annualized vol, decimal or percent (0.62 or 62) — provide iv OR price

limit.description: When coin omitted: number of markets (max 50)

market.description: one market, e.g. BTC (native) or TSLA with dex=xyz

max_drawdown_pct.description: drop vaults whose sampled month drawdown exceeds this % of TVL

metric.description: mark | funding_apr_pct | oi_usd | change_24h_pct | oi_cap_pct | move_since_rule_pct

min_oi_usd.description: Minimum Hyperliquid open interest (USD) to include a coin

min_usage_pct.description: only markets at or above this usage (default 0)

price.description: Option price to solve implied vol from

rule_id.description: FREE status poll: the rule id from registration (with secret); no payment on this path (never send on a registration call)

scan_top.description: accounts to scan: 100, 200 (default) or 400, rounded up to the next bucket

secret.description: FREE status poll: the rule secret from registration (never send on a registration call)

sport.description: filter by sport, e.g. soccer, american football, baseball

spot.description: Spot price — Black-Scholes mode (provide spot OR forward)

symbol.description: one symbol (TSLA, GOLD, JPY, US500, SPCX) — omit for top markets by open interest

symbols.description: comma list of venue symbols (default SP500, XYZ100, 10 mega-caps, GOLD, BRENTOIL; max 25)

tax_year.description: Tax year e.g. 2026. Defaults to current year.

token.description: Optional token contract address to risk-scan via GoPlus (honeypot, buy/sell tax, mint/rug traps)

top.description: top markets per dex by open interest (max 25)

value_tier.description: Approximate holdings value tier used to calibrate custody recommendations

vault.description: one vault address for the detail view

week.description: 0 = latest weekend (live if in progress), 1-4 = earlier weekends

window.description: equity-curve window: day | week | month | allTime (default allTime)

with_daily.description: with one app matched, include its last 30 daily fee points

with_drawdown.description: compute max drawdown for the top 20 (slower)

within_pct.description: distance to liquidation price in percent (default 5, max 25)

name: cryptopulse
